request_state.desc: In the 3 | p branch, p = 3p_prime gives 9p_prime(3p_prime^2 + q^2) = c^3. 9 | c^3 forces 27 | c^3, c = 3c_prime. Then p_prime(3p_prime^2 + q^2) = 3c_prime^3 forces 3 | p_prime, p_prime = 3p_double_prime. Then q^2 + 3(3p_double_prime)^2 = c_prime^3 / p_double_prime, swapping roles with 3 nmid q.
request_state.target: Complete closure of 3 | p branch in EulerDescentStep
